dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent mid-dorsal 'O' ring with a high-contrast white perimeter and medium-grey interior; anterior to this is a smaller, oval-shaped ring; posterior section features two 'C' shaped structures with sharp exterior transitions to dark background pixels.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate concentration of localized high-intensity white pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily situated in the lower-anterior region and as isolated points between the larger ring structures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Primary geometric relationship defined by a triangle connecting the centroids of the large central annulus, the adjacent anterior annulus, and the prominent ring located directly ventral to the central midpoint.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense interlocking cluster of approximately five small circular annuli in the lower-anterior field, creating a high-contrast honeycomb-like texture.
